reviews.text: We had a great time, the staff was impeccable and professional. A special shout-out to Desirée, who always gives our Red a perfect cut!
I had my Yorkshire Terrier's hair thinned out and my Cavalier puppy's nails trimmed, and I was very satisfied, the staff were very kind and highly professional.
Professionalism, hospitality, and so much attention and care. I will definitely be back.
Your pet will appreciate it.

Two harnesses purchased, two harnesses to throw away.
Both ruined in less than a year and a half, with the leather on the leash completely deteriorated, and the second broke just a month after the first. Considering the price, I expected a quality product, not a broken accessory. I do not recommend!

Dangerous…they can't recognize a dog that causes them to dry out, he had heat stroke (strange noise while breathing). If we hadn't taken him to the emergency room right away, I don't know if Negroli would still be alive…(said by the Vet) no excuses…sure, when things go well, they seem good, but in cases like this, you can see the professionalism…NEVER AGAIN

I took my cats to this groomer and was absolutely delighted! 🐾✨
The environment is well-kept, clean, and above all very quiet, which is essential for making our four-legged friends feel at ease.

The professionalism is evident in every detail: precise work, attention, and great care. But what struck me most is the sincere love for animals that shines through in the people who work there ❤️

It's rare to find a place like this: competent but also humane. Highly recommended!

Prilton is an oasis of true well-being for our animals. Gessica has magical hands; she grooms our Nemo with the precision and kindness of a true champion. Nothing is left to chance; I've been bringing my dog ​​here for a while now and I absolutely love it. The owner is truly kind and, above all, very attentive to the animals: Nemo is a bit wary, but he's always at ease with them. After every grooming session, he's clean, smells great, and his fur is meticulously cared for. You can tell they're passionate about their work. Highly recommended!
Fantastic experience, very polite and professional staff
Excellent experience, friendly staff, I will definitely be back.
The only shop where my Doberman is happy to have a bath!!! Excellent and super professional!

We were deeply disappointed with the result, especially considering the €120 cost for stripping and a full grooming (bath, nail clipping, and ear cleaning) for our medium schnauzer. We're very familiar with the practice of stripping, having regularly treated the dog by professionals every two or three months for the past two years. Having moved to another city, we therefore turned to this facility.
Stripping, in fact, wasn't performed: there was no trace of it. According to the breed standard, a schnauzer must be stripped on the back and head and shaved elsewhere, including the intimate area and between the paws, procedures that did not appear to have been performed. The dog appears to have received only a bath and a brush.
We would have liked to pay the right price for such a service or, alternatively, to have been informed of the possible impossibility of properly performing the requested (and repeatedly specified) request, rather than being faced with an unsatisfactory result despite such a high expense. We would now have to turn elsewhere well before the usual timeframe, subjecting the dog to further and immediate stress and spending much more than expected.
The environment is very very clean and the furry friends are treated like real gentlemen or ladies.

I took my dog ​​for grooming and was absolutely delighted! The team is super kind, professional, and clearly loves animals. They treated my little one with great care and attention, and now he's soft, super clean, and smells amazing! 🐶✨
I absolutely recommend this place to anyone looking for quality grooming services and people who know how to make our four-legged friends feel at ease.

After several bad experiences elsewhere, my dog ​​and I finally found the perfect place with Prilton!! The girls are super nice and professional, and above all, they listen to the customer's requests and offer advice based on the dog and its needs! With them, my dog ​​is no longer so afraid of baths 🥰 …
Excellent service. Extremely professional. My go-to place for grooming and treatments for my poodle.
Very kind and my dogs are always beautiful

Everything was perfect! The environment was welcoming and stress-free for the dog, even mine, who doesn't like baths. The staff were friendly and professional. The cleanliness was impeccable. Highly recommended!

Our Golden Retriever, Frank, has found his perfect spa! For at least a year, we've been regularly bringing him to this chic location for grooming, ozone treatments, and teeth cleanings. All services are offered in a welcoming, professional environment at fair prices. The staff is very kind and qualified, attentive to our furry friend's well-being, with that extra touch that sets them apart.
First time here and we had a great time. Courtesy and professionalism at a fair price. The care and passion are evident in the final result!

For several months now, this has been our go-to place for grooming our poodle. Everything is always perfect. The team is truly kind, courteous, helpful, patient, and punctual. The environment is incredibly clean, tidy, and smells amazing, which is not always the case. After trying several groomers, we finally found the right one we can trust and rely on.
Professional, excellent service, my poodle now trusts again and goes to the grooming salon without problems🥰🥰 …

I've been using your precious services for months for my two Persian cats. Before, it was a nightmare with knots, especially for Leo, while Pedrino was more manageable. Since I met them through my vet, my furry little princes are always neat, trimmed, and fantastic. I use their help every two or three weeks. Last but not least, Alessia's honesty and excellent prices are a plus. Thanks to you, my little ones no longer have to undergo any further knotting strategies.
I like the very welcoming place 💯 …

Honestly, I'm a little disappointed. I asked for a quote over the phone, specifying the dog's size, coat length, and the services they'd need, including dewclaws, washing, and a haircut. I was told I'd pay €40 in total. When I paid, it became €50, without clarifying what the extra €10 was for. I reminded them of the quote I'd gotten over the phone and they said, "I don't know who I spoke to." I still paid €50, but this lack of clarity about the total price bothers me and has undermined my trust in this place. I don't think I'll be back. It's a shame.
Friendly staff, very well kept and hospitable place
I took my Leo for the first time today. A wonderful welcome with so much love for my little one. Excellent work! When I came back to pick him up, Leo was truly calm and at peace. Highly recommended!

My 4-month-old German Shepherd puppy, Gea, has had her first bath.
It's an experience I can't wait to repeat: for Gea, because she happily let herself be handled despite her rather uncouth nature, and for us, because we brought home a clean, fragrant, and happy dog. We'll definitely be back within a month to get her used to this pleasant experience.

Well done!!! Washed, clipped, trimmed nails, cleaned ears and adorned my Briciola🐕🐾with a beautiful pink bow😍 In my opinion a little "expensive" but nowadays they all cost more than hairdressers🤷🏽‍♀️😜 …

Exceptional place, the girls are super helpful and attentive to detail, they treat our little animals with dedication and passion, so I highly recommend it and I will never change you ♥️my Ercolino thanks you ❤️
Hi, I took my little girl to this pet spa for the first time and I have to say that the ozone bath and grooming service she received was top notch. Highly recommended. 👍😁 …
Super competent, I highly recommend

Highly recommended! Trevor came out so happy, smelling great, and wearing a bow 🐕‍🦺❤️
We were here today for the first time, and I think I'll always take him here from now on. The environment is not at all stressful for the dog, unlike many others.
The girls are super nice, kind, and helpful!
10 out of 10!
Dear all, this was our dog's first haircut and she came out happy and serene as well as beautiful!

Hi, we went a while ago, recommended by a friend. Luckily, the day I called, there was a free spot, and I flew in.

He lets you touch him, but he doesn't like it, so I went there with the thought: let's hope everything goes well, and I have to say, everything went great. The team is made up of young, friendly, and above all, skilled women.
We washed in a very elegant tub, dried and perfumed by good Milanese dogs.
Zero even had his teeth cleaned, really cool.
Would I recommend it? Absolutely... we'll definitely be back for the renovation in September!!!

Despite Mia's fears, they were able to gain her trust with professionalism and …

we had a great time!

I took my husky to their place for a bath. Even though he's a particularly lively dog ​​and difficult to keep still, the girls did an excellent job. When I picked him up, he was very happy. The bath was done very well.
